description: Write step-by-step instructions to fix one finding, with any secret shown only as a short prefix plus REDACTED. Use it after yof_check, yof_check_diff or yof_findings reports a finding; use yof_explain for background on a rule, and yof_verify once the fix is made. For a key rule pass file (and line), which yof reads locally to find the value; for a package rule pass package. A finding_id, or a rule this computer does not know, is sent to yof.io and needs YOF_API_KEY. Returns rule and instructions, plus file, line and still_in_file for a key finding.

file.description: The file the finding is in, relative to the project root. Required for key rules (secret.*).

finding_id.description: A finding id from yof_findings. When set, the instructions come from yof.io and the other fields are ignored.

line.description: The line of the finding, to pick one match when the file has several. Optional.

package.description: The package name. Required for package rules (package.*).

rule_id.description: The rule id of the finding, for example secret.openai or package.lookalike.

name: yof_fix_prompt

finding_id.description: The yof.io finding id, when one was passed.

instructions.description: The fix instructions, ready to follow.

line.description: The line found in the file, or the line passed in.

still_in_file.description: Whether the value is still in the file (key findings).

title: Fix instructions
